--- game/punch_hitbox.gd
+++ game/punch_hitbox.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+extends Area2D
+
+# The punch hitbox detects overlaps during a short window and calls apply_damage on targets.
+# Expected to be instantiated by a fighter and have 'attacker' and 'damage' properties set.
+
+@export var damage: int = 10
+var attacker: Node = null
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # Create a CollisionShape2D if none exists
+    if not $CollisionShape2D:
+        var cs = CollisionShape2D.new()
+        var shape = RectangleShape2D.new()
+        shape.size = Vector2(40, 30)
+        cs.shape = shape
+        add_child(cs)
+    connect("body_entered", Callable(self, "_on_body_entered"))
+    # Auto-free shortly to make it a transient hitbox
+    await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
+    if is_instance_valid(self):
+        queue_free()
+
+func _on_body_entered(body: Node) -> void:
+    if not is_instance_valid(attacker):
+        return
+    # Don't hit the attacker
+    if body == attacker:
+        return
+    if body.has_method("apply_damage"):
+        var knockback = Vector2(200 * (attacker.facing if attacker.has_method("facing") or hasattr(attacker, "facing") else (1)), -120)
+        # Fallback: if attacker has 'facing' property use it, otherwise use sign of x-direction
+        if hasattr(attacker, "facing"):
+            knockback = Vector2(200 * attacker.facing, -120)
+        body.apply_damage(damage, knockback)
+        # Only hit once
+        queue_free()

+    position = Vector2(200, 420)
+    health = max_health
+    set_physics_process(true)

+func apply_damage(amount: int, knockback: Vector2) -> void:
+    health = max(0, health - amount)
+    # Apply knockback velocity
+    velocity.x = knockback.x
+    velocity.y = knockback.y
+    # Flash white
+    sprite.modulate = Color(1,1,1)
+    await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
+    sprite.modulate = Color(1,1,1,1)

+

+    if ui and ui.game_over:
+        return
+    var input_left = Input.is_action_pressed("ui_left")
+    var input_right = Input.is_action_pressed("ui_right")
+    var move_dir = 0
+    if input_left:
+        move_dir -= 1
+    if input_right:
+        move_dir += 1
+    if move_dir < 0:
+        facing = -1
+    elif move_dir > 0:
+        facing = 1
+    if move_dir != 0:
+        velocity.x = move_dir * speed
+        if move_dir < 0:
+            print("MOVE LEFT")
+        else:
+            print("MOVE RIGHT")
+    else:
+        velocity.x = 0
+    # gravity
+    if not is_on_floor():
+        velocity.y += 20
+    # jump
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_up") and is_on_floor():
+        velocity.y = jump_force
+        print("JUMP")
+    # punch
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_accept"):
+        _do_punch()
+    move_and_slide()
+
+func _do_punch() -> void:
+    print("PUNCH")
+    # tween lunge forward and back - simple velocity impulse
+    var orig_x = position.x
+    var lunge = 20 * facing
+    position.x += lunge
+    await get_tree().create_timer(0.08).timeout
+    position.x = orig_x
+    # spawn hitbox

+    hb.attacker = self
+    hb.damage = 10
+    hb.position = position + Vector2(30 * facing, -10)
+    get_parent().add_child(hb)
+
+func reset(to_pos: Vector2) -> void:
+    position = to_pos
+    health = max_health
+    velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+    if ui:
+        ui.on_health_changed("player", health)

Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement ownership:
  - 0 (game name/title) -> game/project.godot and game/main.tscn (window title).
  - 1 (player visible left) -> game/ui.gd (spawns Player), game/player.gd (renders sprite).
  - 2 (rival visible right) -> game/ui.gd, game/rival.gd.
  - 3 (wooden floor) -> game/main.tscn (ColorRect floor).
  - 4 (light background) -> game/project.godot (clear color) and main.tscn (background via root).
  - 5 (gravity for fighters) -> game/player.gd & game/rival.gd (CharacterBody2D with gravity).
  - 6/7/8 (LEFT/RIGHT/UP controls) -> game/player.gd (InputMap setup in UI but behavior in Player).
  - 9 (SPACE punch) -> game/player.gd + game/punch_hitbox.gd.
  - 10-16 (punch physics, slide, bounce, tween, flash, health loss, rival AI/punch cadence) -> player.gd, rival.gd, punch_hitbox.gd, ui.gd.
  - 17 (health bars) -> ui.gd + main.tscn HUD nodes.
  - 18-19 (win/lose freeze, restart) -> ui.gd with game_over flag, restart via R in ui.gd, fighter reset in player/rival.
  - 20 (Escape quit) -> ui.gd.
  - 21 (control print statements) -> player.gd and ui.gd printing events.
  - 22 (print WIN/GAME OVER) -> ui.gd.

- State ownership:
  - UI (game/ui.gd): owns overall game state: player_health, rival_health, game_over flag, HUD nodes, spawn/reset.
  - Player (game/player.gd) & Rival (game/rival.gd): own their local physics state (position, velocity, facing, health property mirror), and expose apply_damage(amount, knockback_vec) -> void. They call ui.on_health_changed(side, new_health).
  - PunchHitbox (game/punch_hitbox.gd): owner is the fighter that spawns it; it emits a hit to the overlapped body and calls the target's apply_damage.

- Cross-file interfaces (signatures):
  - Player.new(): Node creation. Player has:
    - func apply_damage(amount: int, knockback: Vector2) -> void
    - var ui: Node (set by spawner)
    - var side: String ("player" or "rival")
  - Rival.new(): same interface as Player.
  - PunchHitbox.new(): Area2D that, when enabled, detects bodies and calls target.apply_damage(10, Vector2(knockback, -50))
  - UI methods:
    - func on_health_changed(side: String, new_health: int) -> void
    - func reset_round() -> void

- Coordinate convention:
  - World is 2D pixel coordinates, origin top-left. Floor y = 500; fighters positioned with centered sprites (Sprite2D default centered=true). Facing: left fighter faces right (facing = 1), right fighter faces left (facing = -1). Knockback applied to velocity.x, positive is to right.

- Lifecycle transitions:
  - init: UI._ready() registers input actions, spawns Player & Rival at x=200 and x=600 on floor y.
  - run: physics enabled; player input moves/jumps/punches; rival AI moves/punches.
  - win/lose: when either health <= 0 UI sets game_over = true, shows message, prints to console, fighters stop acting.
  - reset: pressing R calls UI.reset_round(): resets health to 100, repositions fighters, clears velocities and game_over flag; prints RESTART.
  - quit: pressing Escape prints QUIT and calls get_tree().quit().

Now I will write the promised files (main.tscn, project.godot, and all .gd scripts). After writing, I'll run syntax and boot checks.

+++ game/punch_hitbox.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+extends Area2D
+
+# The punch hitbox detects overlaps during a short window and calls apply_damage on targets.
+# Expected to be instantiated by a fighter and have 'attacker' and 'damage' properties set.
+
+@export var damage: int = 10
+var attacker: Node = null
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # Create a CollisionShape2D if none exists
+    if not $CollisionShape2D:
+        var cs = CollisionShape2D.new()
+        var shape = RectangleShape2D.new()
+        shape.size = Vector2(40, 30)
+        cs.shape = shape
+        add_child(cs)
+    connect("body_entered", Callable(self, "_on_body_entered"))
+    # Auto-free shortly to make it a transient hitbox
+    await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
+    if is_instance_valid(self):
+        queue_free()
+
+func _on_body_entered(body: Node) -> void:
+    if not is_instance_valid(attacker):
+        return
+    # Don't hit the attacker
+    if body == attacker:
+        return
+    if body.has_method("apply_damage"):
+        var knockback = Vector2(200 * (attacker.facing if attacker.has_method("facing") or hasattr(attacker, "facing") else (1)), -120)
+        # Fallback: if attacker has 'facing' property use it, otherwise use sign of x-direction
+        if hasattr(attacker, "facing"):
+            knockback = Vector2(200 * attacker.facing, -120)
+        body.apply_damage(damage, knockback)
+        # Only hit once
+        queue_free()

+    health = max_health
+    set_physics_process(true)

+func apply_damage(amount: int, knockback: Vector2) -> void:
+    health = max(0, health - amount)
+    # Apply knockback velocity
+    velocity.x = knockback.x
+    velocity.y = knockback.y
+    # Flash white
+    sprite.modulate = Color(1,1,1)
+    await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
+    sprite.modulate = Color(1,1,1,1)
+    if ui:

+    if ui and ui.game_over:
+        return
+    var input_left = Input.is_action_pressed("ui_left")
+    var input_right = Input.is_action_pressed("ui_right")
+    var move_dir = 0
+    if input_left:
+        move_dir -= 1
+    if input_right:
+        move_dir += 1
+    if move_dir < 0:
+        facing = -1
+    elif move_dir > 0:
+        facing = 1
+    if move_dir != 0:
+        velocity.x = move_dir * speed
+        if move_dir < 0:
+            print("MOVE LEFT")
+        else:
+            print("MOVE RIGHT")
+    else:
+        velocity.x = 0
+    # gravity
+    if not is_on_floor():
+        velocity.y += 20
+    # jump
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_up") and is_on_floor():
+        velocity.y = jump_force
+        print("JUMP")
+    # punch
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_accept"):
+        _do_punch()
+    move_and_slide()
+
+func _do_punch() -> void:
+    print("PUNCH")
+    # tween lunge forward and back - simple velocity impulse
+    var orig_x = position.x
+    var lunge = 20 * facing
+    position.x += lunge
+    await get_tree().create_timer(0.08).timeout
+    position.x = orig_x
+    # spawn hitbox
+    var hb = load("res://punch_hitbox.gd").instantiate()
+    hb.attacker = self
+    hb.damage = 10
+    hb.position = position + Vector2(30 * facing, -10)
+    get_parent().add_child(hb)
+
+func reset(to_pos: Vector2) -> void:
+    position = to_pos
+    health = max_health
+    velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+    if ui:
+        ui.on_health_changed("player", health)

extends Node2D

@onready var player_spawn: Node2D = $PlayerSpawn
@onready var rival_spawn: Node2D = $RivalSpawn
@onready var player_health_rect: ColorRect = $HUD/PlayerHealth
@onready var rival_health_rect: ColorRect = $HUD/RivalHealth
@onready var message_label: Label = $HUD/MessageLabel

var player: Node = null
var rival: Node = null
var game_over: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
    # Input map
    if not InputMap.has_action("ui_left"):
        InputMap.add_action("ui_left")
        var e = InputEventKey.new()
        e.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT
        InputMap.action_add_event("ui_left", e)
    if not InputMap.has_action("ui_right"):
        InputMap.add_action("ui_right")
        var e2 = InputEventKey.new()
        e2.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT
        InputMap.action_add_event("ui_right", e2)
    if not InputMap.has_action("ui_up"):
        InputMap.add_action("ui_up")
        var e3 = InputEventKey.new()
        e3.physical_keycode = KEY_UP
        InputMap.action_add_event("ui_up", e3)
    if not InputMap.has_action("ui_accept"):
        InputMap.add_action("ui_accept")
        var e4 = InputEventKey.new()
        e4.physical_keycode = KEY_SPACE
        InputMap.action_add_event("ui_accept", e4)
    # Restart and quit
    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
        InputMap.add_action("restart")
        var er = InputEventKey.new()
        er.physical_keycode = KEY_R
        InputMap.action_add_event("restart", er)
    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
        InputMap.add_action("quit")
        var eq = InputEventKey.new()
        eq.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
        InputMap.action_add_event("quit", eq)

    spawn_fighters()
    update_health_bars()

func spawn_fighters() -> void:
    # instantiate player and rival using script classes
    var player_script = preload("res://player.gd")
    player = player_script.new()
    player.position = player_spawn.position
    player.ui = self
    add_child(player)

    var rival_script = preload("res://rival.gd")
    rival = rival_script.new()
    rival.position = rival_spawn.position
    rival.ui = self
    rival.target = player
    add_child(rival)

func on_health_changed(side: String, new_health: int) -> void:

class_name Rival

@export var speed: float = 160.0
@export var jump_force: float = -380.0
@export var max_health: int = 100

var health: int = 100
var facing: int = -1 # faces left initially
var ui = null
var target: Node = null
var punch_cooldown: float = 1.0
var _punch_timer: float = 0.0

@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = Sprite2D.new()

func _ready() -> void:
    add_child(sprite)
    var tex = load("res://assets/blue_belt_fighter.png")
    if tex:
        sprite.texture = tex
        sprite.centered = true
        sprite.offset = Vector2.ZERO
    health = max_health
    set_physics_process(true)

func apply_damage(amount: int, knockback: Vector2) -> void:
    health = max(0, health - amount)
    velocity.x = knockback.x
    velocity.y = knockback.y
    sprite.modulate = Color(1,1,1)
    await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
    sprite.modulate = Color(1,1,1,1)
    if ui:
        ui.on_health_changed("rival", health)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
    if ui and ui.game_over:
        return
    if not target:
        return
    var dir = sign(target.position.x - position.x)
    facing = dir
    # move toward player if far
    var dist = abs(target.position.x - position.x)
    if dist > 120:
        velocity.x = dir * speed
    else:
        velocity.x = 0
        # punch if close and cooldown elapsed
        _punch_timer -= delta
        if _punch_timer <= 0:
            _do_punch()
            _punch_timer = punch_cooldown
    # gravity
    if not is_on_floor():
        velocity.y += 20
    move_and_slide()

func _do_punch() -> void:
    print("RIVAL PUNCH")
    # lunge
    var orig_x = position.x
    var lunge = -16 * facing
    position.x += lunge
    await get_tree().create_timer(0.08).timeout
    position.x = orig_x
    var hb = preload("res://punch_hitbox.gd").new()
    hb.attacker = self
    hb.damage = 10
    hb.position = position + Vector2(30 * facing, -10)
    get_parent().add_child(hb)

func reset(to_pos: Vector2) -> void:
    position = to_pos
    health = max_health
    velocity = Vector2.ZERO
    if ui:
        ui.on_health_changed("rival", health)

extends Area2D

# The punch hitbox detects overlaps during a short window and calls apply_damage on targets.
# Expected to be instantiated by a fighter and have 'attacker' and 'damage' properties set.

@export var damage: int = 10
var attacker: Node = null

func _ready() -> void:
    # Create a CollisionShape2D if none exists
    if not has_node("CollisionShape2D"):
        var cs = CollisionShape2D.new()
        var shape = RectangleShape2D.new()
        shape.size = Vector2(40, 30)
        cs.shape = shape
        add_child(cs)
    connect("body_entered", Callable(self, "_on_body_entered"))
    # Auto-free shortly to make it a transient hitbox
    await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
    if is_instance_valid(self):
        queue_free()

func _on_body_entered(body: Node) -> void:
    if not is_instance_valid(attacker):
        return
    # Don't hit the attacker
    if body == attacker:
        return
    if body.has_method("apply_damage"):
        # Compute knockback away from the attacker so the target is pushed correctly
        var dir = 1
        if is_instance_valid(attacker) and attacker.has_method("get_global_position"):
            # Use positions to determine direction: positive to the right
            dir = sign(body.global_position.x - attacker.global_position.x)
            if dir == 0:
                dir = 1
        else:
            # Fallback: assume attacker faces right
            dir = 1
        var knockback = Vector2(200 * dir, -120)
        body.apply_damage(damage, knockback)
        # Only hit once
        queue_free()
